purpose: Verify that the development self executor can replace external OpenRouter/LM Studio inference for every model-dependent workflow node in isolated-step mode.
notes: Each isolated step used the workflow-specific *.self.default model profile and the same ModelStepService request/parse/schema path used by HTTP execution.

The reasoning step intentionally returned a search action first; localMedBot executed evidence.search inside the frozen fixture corpus and supplied the observation in the next self handoff before submit.

Testing exposed and fixed an isolated-step compiler defect: workflow-only review/when transitions are now removed when ancestors/downstream nodes are intentionally absent. The selected node's model/check behavior remains intact.
No OpenRouter or LM Studio endpoint was used for these tests.
